component.name: TransactionTable
component.business_context: Display a paginated and sortable list of transactions with status indicators and drill-down capability

constraints: Columns: date, amount, status, merchant name, payment method
Pagination options: 25, 50, or 100 rows per page
Status values must display as colored badges

missing_states: hover (row) — no hover highlight state specified for interactive rows
focus-visible (row) — keyboard-focused row needs a visible focus ring
loading — initial data fetch and sort/pagination transitions not specified
empty — no rows returned (e.g. no transactions found) state not specified
error — failed data fetch state not specified
sorted-asc / sorted-desc — active sort direction indicator per column header not specified
disabled (pagination controls) — prev/next buttons when on first/last page not specified
loading (pagination) — in-flight state while fetching next page not specified
accessibility_gaps: Table must use a semantic <table> element with <thead>, <tbody>, <th scope='col'> for all column headers
Sortable column headers must have aria-sort='ascending' | 'descending' | 'none' toggled on click
Clickable rows must have role='button' and tabIndex={0} with onKeyDown handling Enter/Space to trigger drill-down, or wrap in an <a> if navigating to a new route
Row click action must be announced — each row needs an aria-label such as 'View transaction from {merchant} on {date}'
Status Badge is purely visual — surrounding row or cell must include visually-hidden text conveying status for screen readers (e.g. 'Status: Failed')
Payment method icons (e.g. Visa, Mastercard) rendered via Icon must use aria-hidden=true when the text label is also present, or a meaningful aria-label when icon-only
Amount column must convey currency — aria-label or visually-hidden text should include currency code (e.g. 'USD 42.00') not just the formatted number
Pagination Select for rows-per-page must have an explicit label (e.g. 'Rows per page') associated via htmlFor
Pagination prev/next IconButtons must have descriptive aria-label='Previous page' and aria-label='Next page'
Disabled pagination buttons must set disabled={true} so they are removed from tab order
Loading state must use aria-busy=true on the table container and Skeleton rows must be wrapped in a container with aria-busy=true
Empty state must include a meaningful text message accessible to screen readers — not just a visual illustration
Error state must use role='alert' or aria-live='polite' to announce the failure to screen readers
Sort trigger buttons inside <th> must be focusable and activated via keyboard (Enter/Space)
responsive_gaps: Touch target for clickable rows must be >= 44px tall on mobile viewports
Sortable column header buttons must have a minimum touch target of 44x44px — consider padding compensation
Pagination prev/next IconButtons must meet 44x44px minimum touch target on mobile
Table horizontal overflow must be handled on narrow viewports — consider a scroll container with overflow-x: auto and a visible scroll affordance
On small screens, consider hiding lower-priority columns (e.g. payment method) or switching to a card-list layout — breakpoint strategy not specified
Rows-per-page Select must remain usable on touch — native select is preferred on mobile for accessibility
Amount and date columns must not truncate on narrow viewports in a way that loses meaning
recommendations: Use Badge with variant='warning' for 'pending', variant='success' for 'completed', variant='danger' for 'failed', and variant='neutral' for 'refunded' to represent transaction statuses
Use Skeleton with variant='rect' and full row width/height during the loading state; wrap the tbody container with aria-busy=true
Use Spinner with size='md' and label='Loading transactions' as an overlay or inline indicator during pagination/sort transitions
Use IconButton with variant='ghost', size='md', aria-label='Previous page', and disabled={isFirstPage} for the previous pagination control
Use IconButton with variant='ghost', size='md', aria-label='Next page', and disabled={isLastPage} for the next pagination control
Use Icon with name='chevron-down' or 'chevron-right' and aria-hidden=true inside sortable column header buttons to indicate sort direction
Use Icon with name='visa', 'mastercard', or 'amex' and aria-hidden=true alongside visible payment method text in the payment method column
Use Select with label='Rows per page' and options=[{value:'25',label:'25'},{value:'50',label:'50'},{value:'100',label:'100'}] for the pagination size control
Use Modal with title='Transaction Details' to render the drill-down view triggered by row click
Use --color-border-subtle for row dividers, --color-brand-primary for focus rings on interactive rows, and --color-focus-ring for focus-visible outlines on sort buttons and pagination controls
Use --spacing-3 or --spacing-4 for row padding to ensure adequate touch target height on mobile
Use --font-size-sm and --font-weight-medium for table cell content; --font-weight-semibold for column headers
